verdict: Paid channels are dark; your only active source is declining.
narrative: In the last 28 days, no spend ran on Meta or Google — both channels were inactive the entire period, producing zero paid leads. Your Google Business Profile was the sole source of inbound activity, generating 96 impressions over 23 days, but recorded zero calls — a sign the call button or call forwarding is broken and silently blocking the one lead path that is live. GBP engagement also dropped 44% week-over-week, so that floor is eroding too. The immediate priority is confirming the call path is working and completing the outstanding setup work — landing pages, conversion tracking, and ad account infrastructure — so paid campaigns can relaunch. Once those foundations are in place, both Meta and Google are scheduled to go live before month-end.
